observations: A continuous visible bone biomask in three-quarter gameplay/promo scene, with warm orange environmental light.
Fine tooth/bone ridges are visible at the reference resolution; forehead and lower face are within frame.
The footer names IllFonic and2024, but that alone does not authenticate publication.
limitations: Feral already has an existingV62 candidate; this does not reduce the46 remaining named targets.
Archive points to official forum patch3.0.0, but that host was previously refused and was not retried.
Single camera, no exact UV/neutral albedo/back geometry; orange lighting is not intrinsic bone color.

documentLimits.count_note: Les 4 peaux créées couvrent 4 entrées de production. Les 2 aspects promotionnels d’armure et les propositions de réemploi restent dans les vérifications ouvertes. Le nombre de PNG désigne uniquement les fichiers textures/, sans les références.

observations: The promo explicitly labels a small mask image EARLY ACCESS / PREDATOR ECLIPSE MASK.
Mask thumbnail is roughly100pixels high: round dark forehead cap, ring-like rim, slanted dark eyes, central narrow elongated lower grille and grey/gunmetal palette.
The red outer glow belongs to the promotional layout, not the physical mask.
The broad silhouette resembles the existing named community-derived Eclipse candidate.
limitations: Source URL chain is archived EpicStore/CDN claims, not freshly downloaded publisher bytes in this audit.
Artwork says ARTWORK SUBJECT TO CHANGE; the small image is not proof of all shipping geometry, fine engraving or a calibrated named swatch.
Existing grey candidate is generated from a secondary icon and is not an exact original default.
Eclipse was already one of the13 secondary candidates, so it does not reduce the46 remaining named targets.

documentLimits.count_note: 175 PNG antérieurs conservés + 15 nouveaux fichiers = 190 PNG. Ce lot comprend 1 révision(s) de matière existante, conservant leur version antérieure, et 2 filets avec alpha réel. Les références, les réemplois et les captures de contrôle ne sont pas comptés comme textures. Une révision de Demon n’est pas une nouvelle teinte officielle. 3 des 28 dossiers précédents disposent maintenant d’une reconstruction observée ; 25 restent ouverts.

observations: Image-left character wears a pale animal-skull facial shell with dark eye openings, nasal cavity, pointed side teeth, and a small red targeting emitter at its image-left temple.
Image-right character wears a dark metal lower-face assembly and a separate dark eyepatch/strap above it; substantial upper-face wearer skin is exposed.
Mask shells must exclude wearer flesh, hair/dreads, shoulder armor, jewelry and weapons.
limitations: Amazon-left/Pirate-right is declared by the source archive and matches Bible prose, but primary named publisher binding was not freshly established.
Keep the masks as separate source-view studies if generated before identity confirmation; do not mark named canonical coverage automatically.
Pirate eyepatch is a separate component. Do not bake eye/skin or recreate hidden strap geometry, and do not infer/mirror anatomical side from a filename.

dualVersionDirection.faithfulVersion: Preserve only actually visible source design, palette and current camera; qualify which work/source is being matched. Generated interpretation never becomes exact original by default.
dualVersionDirection.phgVersion: Standardize rendering resolution, studio light, edge clarity and physically plausible material response while preserving silhouette, openings, anatomy-free components, decoration and original material family. Do not make bone or gold into generic grey metal.

conclusion: No additional named mask among the46 can currently receive a certified exact-original source from these local findings. Feral and Eclipse archived documentary images can assist qualified source-view/PHG direction work for names already represented. HuntingParty2 offers visible shapes but named attribution remains unresolved. This audit does not prove source absence on the whole Web.
